clue.text: Definite cure?

definitions.meaning: a remedy aimed at one particular disease, an old medical noun

explanation.definitionFit: A precise statement is definite; in old medicine a drug targeting one disease was called by this noun.

clue.text: Scoundrels affected in an ocean-going vessel

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: SS is steamship
camp means theatrically affected or mannered

explanation.surface: Villains put on airs aboard a liner.
explanation.definitionFit: Rascals and rogues are mischievous scoundrels.

clue.text: A course that's not way out!

definitions.meaning: a dish served at a meal
the opposite of an exit, so a way in

explanation.surface: A dish that is not too outlandish.
explanation.definitionFit: The French word for an entry names a main dish or a starter, and also admission.

clue.text: The Italian trainees object, being dim

parts.note: IL is the Italian for 'the'
L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates, so two trainees are LL
IT is a pronoun for an object

explanation.surface: Italian apprentices complain about being stupid.
explanation.walkthrough: L plates mark learner drivers in Britain, so L stands for a trainee.
explanation.definitionFit: A badly lighted room is gloomy and dim.

clue.text: Face outside right with a certain lack of discretion

indicators.note: outside means the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: face means cheek or effrontery
R is right

explanation.surface: Being cheeky to a superior is indiscreet.
explanation.definitionFit: Rashness or heedlessness is a lack of prudence and discretion.

clue.text: Rang up and gave a name

definitions.meaning: named, as in christening a baby

explanation.surface: Someone telephoned and gave a name when asked.
explanation.definitionFit: To phone someone is to give them a ring, and to christen a child is to name it: both senses of one verb.

clue.text: A girl should turn up in neat get-up, they feel

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside another
a get-up is an outfit, a rearranged appearance, so the letters are reordered
in a down clue, turning up reads the word from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl ought to arrive in a smart outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A girl' reads as the subject, but 'A' is just an article; in a down entry 'turn up' means read upwards, and 'get-up' (an outfit) signals the rearranged NEAT, ANTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Insects sense their surroundings with these feelers.

clue.text: Delay that is inevitable in underwear production

parts.note: to linger is to delay or dawdle
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Hold-ups are unavoidable in making smalls.
explanation.definitionFit: Women's delicate undergarments, collectively.

clue.text: Some padres sing when getting ready for the day ahead

definitions.text: when getting ready for the day ahead

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some chaplains sing while putting on their clothes in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting on clothes is what one does when preparing for the day.

clue.text: Beast causing a group of conservationists to run off

parts.note: NT is the National Trust, the British body that conserves historic houses and countryside
to elope is to run off secretly to marry

explanation.surface: A creature makes the heritage volunteers bolt.
explanation.walkthrough: The National Trust is the British charity that looks after stately homes and coastline, abbreviated NT.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a horned, deer-like grazing animal, so a beast.

clue.text: The way an engineer sees the position

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way or road
taken as written
CE is Civil Engineer

explanation.surface: An engineer gives his view on where something stands.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance is the way one stands or a stated attitude, a position.

clue.text: Sort of soup with rice cooked in it — very highly esteemed

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are worked over and made into something new

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A recipe for rice soup from someone who values it greatly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' reworks the letters of SOUP and RICE together into the answer; 'Sort of' is surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Something treasured and dearly valued is held very highly in esteem.

clue.text: Assumes an appealing attitude

parts.note: the attitude is a bodily posture, and 'appealing' means begging or pleading, as a suppliant goes down on bended leg

explanation.definitionFit: Getting down on bended legs is the posture of one who appeals or begs.

clue.text: Indulgence shown towards awkward relation

parts.note: to means towards

indicators.note: awkward means clumsy and out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Patience shown to a difficult family member.
explanation.definitionFit: Indulgence is forbearance, putting up with something.

clue.text: To ladies, no make-up means despair

indicators.note: make-up as a verb phrase means put together, so these letters are assembled afresh

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Telling ladies they cannot wear cosmetics brings them misery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make-up' looks like cosmetics but tells you to rearrange TO LADIES NO.
explanation.definitionFit: Utter misery and bleakness of spirit is a synonym for despair.

clue.text: Confessed, so allowed in

explanation.surface: Owned up, and so was let in.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to own up and to let someone enter.

clue.text: Sound, like the taking guy

parts.note: as means like
a pirate is a man who takes what is not his

explanation.surface: A thief sounds off.
explanation.definitionFit: A breathy h sound in phonetics, or to pronounce with that breath.

clue.text: Note with regret not all are revolting

parts.note: G is a note of the musical scale
to rue is to regret
some means part, not all

explanation.surface: A note of regret that some are in rebellion.
explanation.definitionFit: Horrible and disgusting is revolting.

clue.text: Amused or confused?

definitions.meaning: diverted or entertained, an older sense of the word

explanation.definitionFit: One whose attention is drawn away is diverted, which can mean entertained or flustered.

clue.text: Bedding in disorder?

definitions.meaning: straw spread for animals to lie on

explanation.surface: Bedding in a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: Straw for livestock and scattered rubbish share one noun.

clue.text: Absolutely denied involvement

indicators.note: involvement means entanglement, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Flatly denied being part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an emphatic 'certainly', meaning absolutely.

clue.text: An area north of London, it appears, provides only basic housing

parts.note: BEDS is short for Bedfordshire, a county north of London

explanation.surface: A district north of London offers only cheap homes.
explanation.walkthrough: Bedfordshire is an English county just north of London, abbreviated Beds.
explanation.definitionFit: A single rented room for sleeping and living is minimal accommodation.

clue.text: A piece of fir is especially good with these flowers

indicators.note: piece of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A bit of fir tree goes especially well with some blooms.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included 'good with', which are link words: the flowers alone are defined, and 'A' and 'good with' join the parts.
explanation.definitionFit: These are blue or purple garden blooms with sword-shaped leaves.

clue.text: A game girl

definitions.meaning: a card game for one player, solitaire

explanation.surface: A girl who is up for anything.
explanation.definitionFit: The one-player card game known as solitaire in America shares its name with a female forename.

clue.text: Freely tote around a soft drinks dispenser

indicators.note: around means one piece wraps the other
freely means loosely, without fixed order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: P is piano, the musical term for soft

explanation.surface: Carry a fizzy-drinks machine about as you please.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft drinks' looks like a phrase, but 'soft' is P from music notation; 'Freely' scrambles the tote letters, which then go 'around' the inner pair.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot with spout from which tea is poured is a dispenser of drinks.

clue.text: Upright, but far from energetic

definitions.meaning: read cryptically as without a list or tilt, so standing straight

explanation.surface: Someone who stands straight but has no get-up-and-go.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that is not tilting has no list; the everyday sense is lethargic.

clue.text: The weight-watcher is put off grabbing one

indicators.note: grabbing means one piece takes hold of another inside it

parts.note: to deter is to put off or discourage
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A slimmer is discouraged after snatching a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on a slimming regime who watches their weight is on a diet.

clue.text: Indirect arrangement to get out of debt

indicators.note: an arrangement puts the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A roundabout scheme to clear what one owes.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a positive balance at the bank means owing nothing.
